'''Firemist Originium Slug''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A wild creature infected by Originium with extremely high body temperatures. This slug explodes when near death, covering everything nearby with acidic body fluids at boiling temperatures as well as active Originium dust.}}

==Overview==
An unstable variant of [[Acid Originium Slug]], Firemist Originium Slugs are similar to their stable counterpart in term of attacking; They either attack with a ram, which deal Physical damage, or spew out acid and deal Nature damage at five spots. 

What is setting them apart, however, is that Firemist Originium Slugs will self detonate when their HP is below 50%, which kills them in the process, but also deals Physical damage and knock Operators back. Operators that got affected will be attached with an unstable material, which explode and deal Physical damage when receiving damage from other sources. This material wears off after a short period.
